It is called from the save handler in `sticky-note.modal.tsx:42`.

2. **Server REST handler:** `ObsResource1_8.save(Obs)` (`openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs1_8/ObsResource1_8.java:267-271`) calls `Context.getObsService().saveObs(delegate, "REST web service")`, then re-reads the saved obs. I did not read the generic create method in the base resource class that invokes `save`, so that hop is inferred. The create model requires `person`, `obsDatetime` and `concept` (lines 174-191 and 228-239).

3. **Core service:** `ObsServiceImpl.saveObs(Obs, String)` (`openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/impl/ObsServiceImpl.java:105-127`) checks the input, enforces privileges, and routes a new obs to `saveNewOrVoidedObs`. 4. **Data access:** `HibernateObsDAO.saveObs(Obs)` (`openmrs-core/api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/api/db/hibernate/HibernateObsDAO.java:94-110`) persists through `HibernateUtil.saveOrUpdate(sessionFactory.getCurrentSession(), obs)` at line 107. The DAO interface is `ObsDAO.java:36`.
